Question: Asalmualikum, I have problem of prostatists, due to that when i go for urination, after some time of completing urination, when i walk are sit i feel wetness in my private part. Due to this my inner wears gets in touch with that fluid. But this happes some time and some time not. I have consulted many doctors but they say it is ok. Some time i feel it is my imagnation only and some time it seems it is fact. Now, i want to know can i offer nimaz in such clothes are in such state after doing wadhu or i have to change clothes after every urination. In which state my condition comes. Please reply fast. Answer ID: 12375 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 691/510=L/1430) If you feel wetness, check the underpants, if it is stained, wash the cloth as well as the private part. You should not offer salah without washing the impurity. This ruling is applied when the impurity is in size less than one dirham (coin). If it is spread in area more than one dirham the salah will not be valid. It is better for you to use toilet paper or clod after urination. Use water when you are sure that the urine dripping stopped. If the drops discontinue by walking, you should do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
